errorCount.description: The number of errors in the metric result.

warningCount.description: The number of warnings in the metric result.

suggestionCount.description: The number of suggestions in the metric result.

value.description:
The informational value being returned by the metric result. This could be used to present information
for metrics that are computing non-code quality violations like "lines of code" etc.

suppressedErrorCount.description: The number of suppressed errors in the metric result.

suppressedWarningCount.description: The number of suppressed warnings in the metric result.

suppressedSuggestionCount.description: The number of suppressed suggestions in the metric result.

suppressedValue.description: The informational value being returned by the metric result that is suppressed.

title:
Type to store the aggregated statistics to be reported for a {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Result}.
This type enables metric results to return a more granular breakdown of values based on severity.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Result.Stats
